text_block_list.text:
(...—Kitasan invited me to karaoke this 
weekend.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
(I know it is a place for singing 
songs.\nAnd that it is primarily 
established as a space for socializing.)

text_block_list.name: Duramente
text_block_list.text:
"...Zukyun, dokyun...♪ No, that's not 
quite it..."
